formats.key: swap((address callTarget, address approveTarget, bytes targetData, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address[] srcReceivers, uint256[] srcAmounts, address[] feeReceivers, uint256[] feeAmounts, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit) desc, bytes clientData) execution)
effects: The signer sends up to desc.amount of desc.srcToken (ERC-20 via transferFrom to srcReceivers or to the first pools in simple mode, or native ETH via msg.value when srcToken is 0xEeee).
When feeReceivers is not empty and FEE_ON_DST is not set, part of desc.amount goes from the signer to the fee receivers in calldata, and only the rest is swapped.
When FEE_ON_DST is set, the router keeps the output first, sends a fee in dstToken to the fee receivers, and forwards the rest to the recipient.
dstReceiver (or the signer when it is zero) receives desc.dstToken; the code checks that the received balance increase, after fees, is at least minReturnAmount.
On the mainnet build, with PARTIAL_FILL and ETH as the source, the router refunds unspent ETH to the signer and checks only the rate, so less than minReturnAmount can arrive.

The signer sends native ETH as msg.value. The value equals the amount (or 0 for ERC-20) only without the REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH and SIMPLE_SWAP flags. With REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH it is any larger value. In simple mode nothing checks it.
When desc.permit is 224 bytes, the router calls permit on srcToken. This can set the signer's allowance for the router to any value, and that allowance stays after the call.
formats.shown: The screen says 'Swap {amount srcToken} for at least {minReturnAmount dstToken} to recipient {dstReceiver}'. The zero recipient shows as Sender. Fees, flags, permit, executor data and the native value are hidden.

findings.title: swap is payable but shows no @.value; hidden flags let msg.value exceed the amount or skip the check
findings.evidence: MetaAggregationRouterV2.sol swap: `if (_flagsChecked(desc.flags, _SIMPLE_SWAP)) { return swapSimpleMode(...); }` runs before `_collectExtraETHIfNeeded(desc);`. _collectExtraETHIfNeeded: `if (_flagsChecked(desc.flags, _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH)) { require(msg.value > (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0)` . Descriptor: no field with path @.value; `execution.desc.flags` has visible: never.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"@.value","label":"Native value sent","format":"amount","visible":"always"}. Keep 'Swap' as the intent; the sentence does not need the value.

findings.title: swap hides feeReceivers and feeAmounts; part of the amount or output goes to unshown fee receivers
findings.evidence: swap: `desc.amount = _takeFee(desc.srcToken, msg.sender, desc.feeReceivers, desc.feeAmounts, ...)`, and on FEE_ON_DST `_takeFee(desc.dstToken, address(this), ...)`. _takeFee: `_doTransferERC20(token, ..., recipients[i], amount)`. Descriptor: 'Fee Receivers' and 'Fee Amounts' have visible: never. The amount sent and the minimum received stay correct bounds, because the fee comes from inside them.
findings.fix: Show execution.desc.feeReceivers.[] (addressName) and execution.desc.feeAmounts.[] (tokenAmount) with visible ifNotIn [] or optional, labelled 'Fee recipient' and 'Fee'.

findings.title: swap shows 'at least minReturnAmount', but on mainnet PARTIAL_FILL with ETH input only checks a rate
findings.evidence: Mainnet _checkReturnAmount: `if (_flagsChecked(desc.flags, _PARTIAL_FILL)) { require(returnAmount * desc.amount >= desc.minReturnAmount * spentAmount` . _executeSwap refunds `desc.amount - spentAmount` when `_isETH(desc.srcToken)`. Descriptor: interpolatedIntent 'for at least {execution.desc.minReturnAmount}'; flags have visible: never.
findings.fix: No flag-bit format exists. Label the field 'Minimum to receive (pro rata if partially filled)', or note the flag limit in the descriptor.

findings.title: swap hides desc.permit, which can set a lasting allowance on srcToken larger than the amount
findings.evidence: Permitable._permit: `if (permit.length == 32 * 7) { address(token).call(abi.encodePacked(IERC20Permit.permit.selector, permit))`. Descriptor: 'Permit' path execution.desc.permit has visible: never.
findings.fix: Show execution.desc.permit when it is not empty, or show its value word with a slice and the tokenAmount format plus a threshold for 'Unlimited'.

findings.title: swap tests cover only ERC-20 input with no fee, no permit, zero value and no special flags
findings.evidence: cases/0.json and cases/1.json: value '0', flags 0x200, feeReceivers empty, permit empty. No case has ETH input (0xEeee), REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH, SIMPLE_SWAP, FEE_ON_DST or a fee.
findings.fix: Add cases for ETH input with nonzero value, for a fee on the source and on the destination, and for simple mode.

findings.title: swap test screens show raw integers such as 1471080000 instead of token-formatted amounts
findings.evidence: cases/0.json screen: 'Amount to Send' = '1471080000', 'Minimum to Receive' = '2998482878911860715861'. The descriptor uses tokenAmount with tokenPath execution.desc.srcToken and execution.desc.dstToken, so the renderer did not resolve the token.

findings.title: swap hides callTarget, targetData and srcReceivers; the router checks the output only by balance change
findings.evidence: swap: `_executeSwap(execution.callTarget, abi.encodeWithSelector(IAggregationExecutor.callBytes.selector, execution.targetData), ...)`. _transferFromOrApproveTarget: `require(total <= desc.amount, 'Exceeded desc.amount')`. The fields are visible: never. The amount, the minimum and the recipient still bound the outcome.

findings.format: swap((address callTarget, address approveTarget, bytes targetData, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address[] srcReceivers, uint256[] srcAmounts, address[] feeReceivers, uint256[] feeAmounts, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit) desc, bytes clientData) execution)
findings.title: swap is payable but shows no @.value; hidden flags let msg.value exceed the amount or skip the check
findings.reason: swap is payable, and no path forces msg.value to equal the amount shown. With _SIMPLE_SWAP set, swap returns through swapSimpleMode before _collectExtraETHIfNeeded runs. swapSimpleMode only requires a non-ETH srcToken and never checks msg.value or refunds it, so any ETH sent stays in the router. With _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH set, the check is only msg.value > amount. For an ETH srcToken, _takeFee then starts from msg.value, so the whole msg.value goes to the fee receivers and callTarget, which is more than the amount shown. The descriptor has no @.value field and keeps flags at visible: never, so the screen never shows how much ETH leaves the wallet.
findings.quote: MetaAggregationRouterV2.sol swap: `function swap(SwapExecutionParams calldata execution) external payable` … `if (_flagsChecked(desc.flags, _SIMPLE_SWAP)) { return swapSimpleMode(...); }` then `_collectExtraETHIfNeeded(desc);` → `if (_flagsChecked(desc.flags, _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH)) { require(msg.value > (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0), 'Invalid msg.value'); }`; swapSimpleMode: `require(!_isETH(desc.srcToken), ...)` and no msg.value check; swap: `desc.amount = _takeFee(..., _isETH(desc.srcToken) ? msg.value : desc.amount, feeInBps)`. Descriptor swap format: fields only on desc.amount, minReturnAmount, dstReceiver; `{"label": "Flags", "path": "execution.desc.flags", "visible": "never"}`; no @.value field.

findings.format: swap((address callTarget, address approveTarget, bytes targetData, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address[] srcReceivers, uint256[] srcAmounts, address[] feeReceivers, uint256[] feeAmounts, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit) desc, bytes clientData) execution)
findings.title: swap is payable but shows no @.value; hidden flags let msg.value exceed the amount or skip the check
findings.reason: The extra-ETH flag permits native value above the displayed amount, and the native-input swap forwards that value to the executor. The descriptor shows only the source-token amount, minimum received, and beneficiary; it never shows transaction value.
findings.quote: contracts/1-0x6131b5fae19ea4f9d964eac0408e4408b66337b5/src/contracts/MetaAggregationRouterV2.sol, _collectExtraETHIfNeeded: `require(msg.value > (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0), 'Invalid msg.value');`. In swap's fee-on-destination branch, _executeSwap receives `_isETH(desc.srcToken) ? msg.value : 0`; _executeSwap forwards it with `(bool success, ) = callTarget.call{value: value}(targetData);`. descriptor.json, swap: `"interpolatedIntent": "Swap {execution.desc.amount} for at least {execution.desc.minReturnAmount} to recipient {execution.desc.dstReceiver}"`; `"path": "execution.desc.flags", "visible": "never"`. Its Amount to Send field uses `execution.desc.amount`; no field uses `@.value`.
